title: Laredo Man Pleads Guilty to Turning Stolen Glock Into Machine Gun Used to Kill Alabama Officer
excerpt: A Laredo man has pleaded guilty to a federal charge after prosecutors said he turned a stolen Glock into a machine gun and gave it to another man, who used it in 2019 to kill a police officer in Huntsville, Alabama, according to KGNS.
content:
A gun converted into a machine gun in Laredo was later used to kill a police officer in Alabama, and the man who converted it has pleaded guilty to a federal charge, according to KGNS.

Prosecutors said Hector Alonzo admitted to turning a stolen Glock into a machine gun. He then gave the gun to Lajeromeny Brown, along with marijuana, prosecutors said.

In 2019, Brown used that gun to kill an officer in Huntsville, Alabama. Brown was later convicted of capital murder and sentenced to death.

Alonzo faces up to life in federal prison. He will be sentenced at a later date.

Source: KGNS, Nov. 20, 2026.
